segments.name: Wireless networking and access networking
products: hosted private cloud-based software tools and applications
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells wireless transport and access networking products, solutions and services to communications service providers and private network operators globally.
segments.evidence: Aviat operates in one reportable business segment: the design, manufacturing and sale of a range of wireless networking and access networking products, solutions and services.

revenueModel.text: Customers, including communications service providers and private network operators, pay for wireless networking products, professional services, maintenance and support contracts, and hosted software-as-a-service.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue from product sales, recognized at a point-in-time, is generated predominately from the sales of products manufactured by third-party manufacturers to whom we have outsourced our manufacturing processes.
